title: Gasless Tx Library: Empowering Cardano dApps & DAOs to Sponsor Gas Fees to Increase User Base and Adoption - Open-source

ms.promise:
Technical Specification Document: A comprehensive design document that details the architecture of the gasless transaction library, including components like API endpoints, data flow diagrams, and system integration strategies.
Development & Testing Plan: A clear plan for developing the library, including the selection of development tools and a gantt timeline chart to execute the plan.
ms.criteria:
We will ensure that the proposed design meets the required functionality and integration capabilities. Anyone with knowledge of cardano development can cross check and verify as it is open source. We will get a feedback statement from the NMKR team regarding the doc to validate this.

The doc will also have gantt timeline chart to execute the plan.

ms.promise:
A functional gasless transaction library that demonstrates the core functionality, including the ability to manage gas fees behind the scenes.
Initial documentation that provides guidance on how to integrate the library with Cardano dApps.
ms.criteria:
The library must successfully demonstrate the elimination of gas fees on the user end and provide a simple library for platforms to integrate.
The integration guidelines sufficient for developers to begin testing the integration with their dApps.
